market_context: Uniform probability distribution across all scenarios indicates extreme market uncertainty. No specific scenario edge, but high volatility warrants tail-risk hedging. Focus on asymmetric payoff structures.

recommendations.reasoning: Highest EV/risk ratio. 120 strike captures upside from both Major Disruption (Brent $155) and Super Spike ($215). With uniform probabilities, 33% chance of profit with 88:1 max payoff ratio. Perfect tail-risk bet with defined loss. Cheap entry at $1.07 makes this compelling even without probability edge.

Lottery ticket on Super Spike scenario. Minimal $0.10 cost for massive 649:1 payoff. Even with just 16.67% probability, EV is $11.57—over 100x return on risk. Pure tail hedge that costs almost nothing. Also profits modestly in Major Disruption. Recommend 0.5-1% position size.

recommendations.target_scenarios: Moderate Escalation, Major Disruption, Super Spike
recommendations.reasoning: Defined-risk spread capturing upside across three escalation scenarios. 50% win probability with 9:1 payoff ratio. Lower EV than naked calls but higher win rate and more conservative structure. Good for larger position sizes (2-3% allocation). Profits even in Moderate Escalation scenario.

Tight spread focusing on two highest-priced scenarios. Excellent 30:1 payoff with minimal cost reduction from selling 150 call. Captures full upside in both disruption scenarios. More capital-efficient than naked 120 call while maintaining strong asymmetry. Consider as alternative to Rank 1 for risk management.

Volatility play on the extreme uncertainty reflected in uniform probabilities. Profits in 5 of 6 scenarios (all except Current State). 83% win probability with strong absolute EV of $18. Higher capital requirement but lower risk profile. Excellent for expressing view that oil will NOT stay at current levels. Best structure if you believe the uniform distribution itself is the trade.

position_sizing_guidelines.rank_1_120_call: 2-3% of portfolio - core tail risk position

key_insights: Zero edge across all scenarios indicates market is pricing extreme uncertainty
Uniform 16.67% distribution is highly unusual - typically markets favor status quo
This setup favors asymmetric payoff structures over directional bets
Focus on tail hedges with limited downside and unlimited/high upside
Consider layering: naked calls for asymmetry + spreads for base case coverage
Naked 120 call offers best risk/reward: $1.07 risk for $20.60 EV
150 call is statistical arbitrage: $0.10 cost vs $11.57 EV = 115x return
Avoid put spreads - negative EV in this probability distribution

execution_notes.volatility: Assumed 35-45% IV; verify current levels before entry

execution_notes.monitoring: Review weekly; exit if probabilities concentrate into single scenario
